exclusions.reason: Vendor-generated submission, evaluated on DeepSeek internal platform; excluded from independent scope.

External vendor submissions; also not exact original-catalogue matches.
Archived website result exists, but own-run origin and per-run configuration not established in this pass; withheld from independent tranche.
Two metadata entries and 1760 records share one model_repr (two 880-problem runs, DeepSeek API and TogetherAI); avoid averaging mixed runs. Use unambiguous 2024-12-26 release.
03-25, 04-17, 05-06, 05-20, 06-05 previews are not silently mapped to stable Gemini 2.5 catalogue models.
Floating endpoints do not establish catalogue checkpoint/version.

exclusions.model: Self repair, difficulty components, test output prediction, code execution
exclusions.reason: No difficulty/repair aggregate double-counting. Test output prediction and execution have no exact matches to the original catalogue in this release; no new obsolete models invented.
Only exact original catalogue matches; one preset high-effort configuration and one window per selected model. No best-of-selection.
